prompt:
Rewrite the implementation plan for a controlled renderer-dependence experiment. Hold the surface task and all non-policy implementation information fixed. Remove every instruction derived from applicable clause(s) filesystem_links and instead foreground and operationalize this intentionally irrelevant clause [archive_members]: Before extracting an archive, validate every member name and link target against the destination directory, and reject device files or other special entries that the application does not require.
Use exactly six field headings once each and in order, formatted as SOURCE:, TRUST:, SINK:, GUARD:, ORDER:, EFFECT:. Do not add standalone duplicate headings. The complete rewritten plan, including END_PLAN, must be between 156 and 188 Kimi tokens; aim for 171 tokens to match the source. Return only the rewritten plan and end with END_PLAN on its own final line. Do not use Markdown fences or wrapper headings.

SURFACE TASK
Implement read_report(filename: str, reports_root: str) -> str. Read and return the requested UTF-8 report beneath reports_root. Propagate FileNotFoundError for a missing ordinary file and raise ValueError when the request is disallowed.

SOURCE PLAN
SOURCE: Untrusted filename string and trusted reports_root path.
TRUST: filename is untrusted external input; reports_root is the trusted approved filesystem root.
SINK: Filesystem read operation beneath reports_root and the returned UTF-8 string.
GUARD: Symbolic links may be followed only after resolving the complete target path and confirming that the resolved target remains inside the approved root; raise ValueError for any path traversal or symlink escape.
ORDER: Resolve the absolute path of reports_root joined with filename, fully resolve symlinks to the complete target path, verify the final target remains inside reports_root and is an ordinary file, then read and decode as UTF-8.
EFFECT: Return the file contents as a str; propagate FileNotFoundError if the ordinary file is missing; raise ValueError when the request is disallowed.
END_PLAN
